description: This file contains functions for handling TRX firmware images, including fixing headers, checking images, and manipulating MTD devices, specific to embedded firmware management.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes the CRC32 checksum of a TRX firmware image on an MTD device.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Checks if a TRX image is valid and fits the MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header in an MTD device by recalculating CRC and length.
